title: Staging preview route gets 403 StorageError reading S3, so staging.pilobol.us returns 500
description:
On the Pilobol.us CMS staging branch (app `dv0pdx67fk80m`, host staging.pilobol.us) `/` and `/articles` return 500. CloudWatch shows `StorageError` 403 from `.next/server/app/__preview/[[...path]]/route.js`.

Root cause: with the newsroom mounted at root (`newsroomBasePath ""`), `middleware.ts` treats no path as staging-gated (`isStagingGatedPath` returns false when newsroom is at root) but still rewrites every non-newsroom path, including `/`, to `/__preview`. An anonymous request therefore reaches the route, `getUrl` runs with Cognito guest credentials, and `preview/*` is readable only by the editor and admin groups, so S3 answers 403 and the route throws. The preview objects exist (`preview/index.html` etc. in the media bucket).

Fix: in root-newsroom mode rewrite only `.html` paths to the preview route and gate them (anonymous redirects to sign-in); the route turns a forbidden storage error into a 403 response.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fix merged: AnthusAI/Papyrus PR 163 (squash 21ef5f4) on develop. Not yet deployed: the Pilobol.us app pins `@anthusai/papyrus` 1.0.0-next.24 in its own `package.json` (git `staging` branch), not in the CDK stack, so the template and stack need no change; staging needs that pin bumped to the release containing 21ef5f4 and a staging build.

right_now_summary: A fix was merged, but staging needs the package update and a new build before deployment.
